issues.concern: The gloss 'waking up' is slightly misleading as 起床 primarily implies getting out of bed, not just becoming conscious.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'waking up' from the main gloss or clarify its secondary nature.

issues.concern: The translation 'I wake up' is less precise than 'I get up' given the nuance of 起床.
issues.suggestion: Change 'I wake up at 6 o'clock every day.' to 'I get up at 6 o'clock every day.'

issues.concern: The translation 'people wake up' is less precise than 'people get up' given the nuance of 起床.
issues.suggestion: Change 'In the military, people wake up to the reveille bugle.' to 'In the military, people get up to the reveille bugle.'

issues.concern: The translation 'my wake-up time has become earlier' and 'Getting up at 5 AM' are inconsistent in their rendering of 起床.
issues.suggestion: Change 'my wake-up time has become earlier' to 'my getting-up time has become earlier' for consistency with 'Getting up at 5 AM'.
